scope: CPU saved arrays and scalar ledger only; no simulation, renderer, AD or Torch

memory.scope: Torch allocator; not full process/device peak

least.selectionScope: Earliest strict lexicographic minimum among recorded finite/numerically valid evaluations; only final least arrays retained.

actualWork.scope: New G0, one observation-only search and at most one paid complete final verification; no reference simulation

limitations: No independent renderer, AD or full dynamics rerun. Intermediate state_metrics remain producer measurements.
